notes: Typical response windows by notice type. These are fallbacks — always prefer the deadline printed on the notice itself. 'source' indicates whether the clock typically runs from issue or receipt; this is disputed, so we never assert it.

deadlines.name: Defective return
deadlines.notes: 15 days from date of intimation to correct the defect

deadlines.name: Inquiry before assessment
deadlines.notes: Typically 15 days; check the notice for the exact date

deadlines.name: Intimation — processing of return
deadlines.notes: 30 days to respond if there is a demand or adjustment

deadlines.name: Notice for reassessment
deadlines.notes: Typically 30 days; must file return or respond

deadlines.name: Show-cause before reassessment
deadlines.notes: 7 to 30 days depending on case; check the notice

deadlines.name: Notice of demand
deadlines.notes: 30 days from service of notice to pay demand

deadlines.name: Set off of refunds
deadlines.notes: 30 days to respond to proposed set-off
